facts.text: Located directly in Dresden's historic city centre, the Innere Altstadt, a few steps from sights such as the Semper Opera House, Royal Palace, Zwinger and Frauenkirche.
facts.excerpt: directly in Dresden's historic city centre "Innere Altstadt" - only a few steps away from the most renowned sights, such as Semper Opera House, Royal Palace, Zwinger and the Church of Our Lady (Frauenkirche)

facts.text: The MICHELIN Guide 2025 awarded the hotel two MICHELIN Keys.
facts.excerpt: The MICHELIN Guide 2025 has awarded Hotel Taschenbergpalais Kempinski Dresden two MICHELIN Keys

facts.text: The Semperoper is a two-minute stroll (200 metres) from the hotel across Theaterplatz.
facts.excerpt: A two-minute stroll (200 metres) across Theaterplatz.

facts.text: August the Great built the Taschenberg Palace for his mistress, Anna Constantia.
facts.excerpt: Aside from the Taschenberg Palace, which he built for his mistress, Anna Constantia

facts.text: The hotel welcomes dogs exclusively; other pets cannot be accommodated.
facts.excerpt: To cater to the needs of our four-legged guests, we welcome dogs exclusively.

facts.text: Dogs receive a dog bed, blanket, feeding bowl and snacks, and there is an a la Carte Dog Menu.
facts.excerpt: a dog bed and a cosy blanket, a shiny new feeding bowl, exciting walks, a selection of little snacks and titbits and, of course, the à la Carte Dog Menu

facts.text: Les Clefs d'Or concierges can assist with ticket reservations, private tours and recommendations.
facts.excerpt: Let our Les Clefs d’Or concierges assist with ticket reservations, private tours and insider recommendations.

facts.text: The hotel has one charging station for Tesla vehicles and two for electric cars.
facts.excerpt: the Taschenbergpalais has one charging station for Tesla vehicles and two charging stations for electric cars

facts.text: Pre-theatre dinner can be had at Das Palais or Kastenmeiers.
facts.excerpt: an exquisite pre-theatre dinner at Das Palais or Kastenmeiers.

facts.text: Dresden International Airport is about 10.7 km from the hotel, around 20 to 30 minutes by car depending on traffic.
facts.excerpt: Dresden International Airport is about 10.7 km (6.1 miles) away from the hotel, which is about 20 to 30 minutes by car depending on traffic

facts.text: The closest public transport stop is Postplatz, served by several tram lines and two bus lines.
facts.excerpt: The closest stops to Hotel Taschenbergpalais Kempinski is "Postplatz" (Tram lines 1, 2, 4, 8, 9, 11, 12; Busses 62, 94).

facts.text: The concierge can arrange out-of-hours tours of the Green Vault as part of the GHA Experience.
facts.excerpt: our concierge can arrange out-of-hours tours of the Green Vault as part of the GHA Experience.

facts.text: Moritzburg Castle is about a 20-minute drive from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: A mere 20 minutes’ drive from the hotel delivers you cleanly into the 18th century.

facts.text: From the city centre, the banks of the Elbe can be reached in just a few minutes.
facts.excerpt: You can reach the banks of the Elbe directly from the city centre in just a few minutes.

facts.text: Dresden levies an accommodation tax of 6% of the gross accommodation cost, which is already included in the hotel's quoted rates.
facts.excerpt: The tax rate is 6% of the gross accommodation cost. Please note that this tax is already included in our quoted rates.

facts.text: A parking space in the underground car park can only be guaranteed when using the valet parking service.
facts.excerpt: a parking space in the underground car park can only be guaranteed when using our valet parking service.
